deployment_comment: Single instance defaults are shown. For multiple replicas, use one Redis, a unique deployment_instance_id per replica, the same deployment_cluster_id, and mount media_dir as shared read/write storage before setting shared_media=true.
grok_comment: Grok Build CLI upstream (cli-chat-proxy.grok.com/v1). Accounts with credential_type="oauth" + oauth_access_token/oauth_refresh_token/oauth_expires_at use this. All fields optional; defaults shown.
egress_comment: Egress proxy pool + FlareSolverr + Cloudflare clearance auto-refresh. Disabled by default; keep grok_egress_enabled=false unless you run multiple exit nodes.
fidelity_comment: Upstream fidelity: the gateway relays client content verbatim by default. Set to explicitly re-enable legacy rewriting.
